info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Corporate Finance Private Placement-spec
info.description: The Corporate Finance Private Placement API enables financial institutions to facilitate and manage private placement transactions efficiently. This API provides the necessary operations to create and submit requests for corporate finance offerings, allowing users to engage with potential investors directly. Typical consumers of this API include investment banks and financial advisors who need to streamline the placement of corporate securities. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their capital raising efforts in a structured manner.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate a private placement within corporate finance. It is designed for brokers and financial institutions to submit offers for private placements efficiently and securely.
